description: This PHP class defines the data transfer object (DTO) for leave entitlement search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It extends a date range filter class and includes properties such as employee number(s), leave type ID, and deletion status, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filter parameters when searching for leave entitlements, including employee identifiers, leave type details, and sorting options.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number (ID) used as a filter criterion for a single employee.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number (ID) for filtering leave entitlements for a specific employee.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers, allowing filtering for multiple employees.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets an array of employee numbers for filtering leave entitlements for multiple employees.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave type used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID used as a filter.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the leave type has been marked as deleted, used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Sets the leave type deletion status filter.
